description: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission found Zepto charged more than the maximum retail price for groceries. Advocate K Shiva Ganesh filed a complaint regarding inflated prices on Zepto's platform. The commission determined that this practice was misleading and constituted unfair trade. Zepto was directed to compensate the complainant and deposit funds into the legal aid account. The company was also instructed to discontinue such practices in the future.

description: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has firmly denied rumors of discord between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and IDF Chief Eyal Zamir, despite rising concerns about possible military actions against Iran amidst an election cycle. To break free from this cycle, distinguishing facts from perceptions and taking actionable strides can prove beneficial.

He argues that implementing it nationally would mitigate wealthy individuals relocating to avoid taxes. Kirby also proposed increasing inheritance taxes to ensure fairness in the tax system. In a recent interview, he suggested requiring national service for all Americans to promote civic responsibility.

description: In 2022, Kim Kardashian bought a Malibu mansion previously owned by supermodel Cindy Crawford. Notably, existing vehicle owners are not required to make any modifications.

This case originated in 2018 due to remarks Gandhi made about Amit Shah during a rally. Vijay Mishra, a local BJP politician, filed the complaint alleging Gandhi's comments were defamatory. The hotel argued that the service charge was discretionary and optional.

title: Google CEO Sundar Pichai admits that cloud business is forgoing short-term revenues

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Thousands gathered in Prague to protest government proposals affecting public television and radio funding. The planned changes would replace licence fees with state budget allocations, raising concerns about media independence. Critics argue that these measures may expose broadcasters to political pressure and reduce their financial stability. Public media employees announced plans for a strike on November 3, with a larger rally scheduled for November 15.
title: 'Had enough': Thousands protest in Prague against Czech govt's media funding overhaul

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Tension brews within Israel's leadership as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and IDF chief Eyal Zamir disagree on possible military action against Iran. This clash before elections raises eyebrows about political motives behind military strategies. Netanyahu highlights the imminent threat Iran poses and urges immediate action during Trump's administration. As the election approaches, Netanyahu faces tight competition from Gadi Eisenkot, suggesting possible political deadlock with no clear majority in view.
title: 'Utilizing Iran for politics': IDF chief, Netanyahu clash over military action

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Jamia Millia Islamia has ordered the holding of students' union elections within 15 days after constitutional approval. The university revoked disciplinary actions taken against students during recent protests and issued an inquiry into security conduct. Protesting students will publicly apologize for statements made against the administration and remove related social media posts. Classes will be conducted online amid the current tensions on campus.
title: After 2 decades, Jamia Millia Islamia announces resumption of student union elections

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Amit Mishra faced significant challenges after being excluded from the Indian cricket team for an extended period. He battled depression for 18 months, questioning his performance while continuing to play. A conversation with a selector helped him realize he needed to improve his domestic performance to succeed. After reflecting on his situation, he managed to return to the Indian team in 2008.
title: 'What did I do wrong?': How being dropped from India team pushed ex-star into depression

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Bhikan Rojekar from Jalgaon Sapkal village secured AIR 812 in the challenging UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025. His journey spanned several years where he encountered numerous hurdles yet remained laser-focused on his dream. With substantial support from a Maharashtra government scholarship for his studies in Delhi, Rojekar highlights the necessity of having a backup career plan even while chasing ambitious goals.
title: Missed MBBS by one mark in 2016; decade later clears UPSC with AIR 812

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Meta Platforms has revealed an innovative structure of new Class C shares, empowering CEO Mark Zuckerberg to sustain his voting dominance. This strategic maneuver is aimed at enhancing opportunities for capital enhancement, rewarding employees, and pursuing acquisitions, especially in the realm of artificial intelligence. Each shareholder will be granted one Class C share for every Class A or B share held, with trading slated to begin on January 19, 2027.
title: Meta to give all shareholders new Class C stock as Zuckerberg eyes wealth tax bill

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Devdutt Padikkal fell one run short of a double century during the first unofficial Test match. He was dismissed for 199 runs after an appealed catch decision by the umpire. Padikkal's innings helped India A recover from an early collapse in their second innings. India A had been bowled out for 113 runs in their first innings. His contribution was significant despite the disappointing nature of his dismissal.
title: Just one run short! Devdutt Padikkal falls for 199; reaction to umpire goes viral

author: TNN
description: Muskan Simolia collapsed and died shortly after checking into a hotel with her husband Nilesh. Her father has accused Nilesh of murder following her unexpected collapse near the hotel room's entrance. CCTV footage shows the moments leading to her fall but does not clarify the cause of her collapse. Investigators are examining the circumstances surrounding her death and have detained her husband for questioning.
title: What happened in 5 seconds? Newlywed enters hotel room, collapses at door before death

author: NEEL KAMAL
description: Two individuals have died and two others are hospitalized following gunfire in Angadpura locality. Authorities identified the deceased as Sahil Jindal and Gagan Jindal, who were cousins. Witnesses report at least 15-20 rounds were fired by assailants from a Black Scorpio SUV. Police have initiated an investigation and recovered three shells from the scene. Families of the victims have named suspects, suggesting personal enmity may be involved.
title: '15-20 rounds fired': 2 killed, 2 injured as assailants open fire outside homes in Punjab

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: A Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh, claiming to protect the capital. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree described King Khalid International Airport as unsafe for travellers and staff. The airport administration designated terminals for domestic and international flights despite warnings. Additionally, attacks against Yemeni civilian sites by Saudi warplanes were claimed to be extensive. Claims made by both sides regarding missile interceptions and airstrikes remain unverified.
title: Riyadh airport partially reopens: Saudi intercepts Houthi ballistic missile, drones

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Shadab Khan led a remarkable comeback for Pakistan against England by scoring an unbeaten 113 runs. Together with Haris Rauf, they built a record-breaking partnership for the last wicket in ODI history. Earlier, England posted a total of 241 runs, with Ben Duckett scoring 105 runs. Pakistan struggled initially but managed to chase down the target after being at 154-9.
title: 'I don't think we can reveal on live TV': Shadab Khan on chat with Haris Rauf

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: HHNBAhead of the crucial Israeli elections, Donald Trump has thrown his support behind Benjamin Netanyahu, underlining the critical role their alliance plays in countering Iran's threats to both nations. Trump praised Netanyahu's effectiveness as a leader throughout their joint military efforts, despite previous tensions regarding their strategies towards Iran. This endorsement marks a notable moment as it's uncommon for a sitting U.S.
title: ‘Vote for Netanyahu’: Trump urges Israelis to re-elect ‘outstanding warrior’ PM

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: Elon Musk claimed that Ukraine breached Starlink's terms of service by using it for offensive strikes. Serhii Beskrestnov challenged Musk's assertions concerning the operational restrictions imposed on Starlink in Ukraine. Ukrainian officials indicated that these restrictions significantly impaired their drone operations. Meanwhile, Ukraine is exploring alternative satellite communication networks to reduce reliance on foreign providers. Musk's assertion has led to growing concerns regarding the support provided by SpaceX to Ukraine.
title: ‘Physically impossible’: Ukraine disputes Musk’s Starlink claim drone strike claim

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft's withdrawal from the crucial data centre partnership with Nscale marks a significant hurdle for its operations in Essex. The agreement failed due to ongoing electricity connection delays, which must be promptly addressed. Despite this challenge, Nscale is determined to pursue its expansion plans in the UK and is exploring alternative energy options.
title: Microsoft tells UK data centre developer ‘not possible’ as power supply delayed to 2030

author: ABHINAV RAJPUT
description: Delhi plans to prohibit entry of vehicles not meeting BS6 emission standards in NCR from November 2026. Over 10 lakh vehicles in Gurgaon, Faridabad, Noida, Greater Noida, and Ghaziabad may be affected. Gurgaon and Faridabad hold around 2 lakh vehicles below BS6 standards, mostly consisting of BS3 and BS4 categories. Additionally, approximately 50,000 commercial vehicles in both locations do not comply with the new regulations.
title: Over 10 lakh NCR vehicles won't be able to enter Delhi from November 1

author: AASTHA JHA
title: Protesters dragged, knocked down: French police charges right into crowd; watch

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: ‘Brazil is no one’s backyard’: Lula’s swipe at US after Bolsonaro’s defeat

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: John and Sandra Mitchell have won a court case against their homeowners association regarding garage construction plans. They proposed a 24-by-28-foot garage with metal siding, which the board initially rejected. The court ruled that the association overstepped its authority by denying the materials without clear restrictions. The violation notice against their property was ordered to be removed from public records.
title: Metal garage rejected by HOA in US; court cancels violation notice

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices experienced a decline of over 1% after hitting six-month peaks, primarily due to geopolitical unrest in Saudi Arabia. Currently, Brent crude fluctuates around $115 per barrel, and WTI at $101.5 per barrel. The threat to energy exports and infrastructure from Houthi attacks raises alarm, while the Federal Reserve meeting looms, potentially addressing inflation amid climbing energy prices.
title: Crude prices fall from six-month highs; WTI stands at $101 per barrel, Brent costs $115

author: TNN
title: Dalal Street braces for volatile week

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A property dispute in Kansas involved two landowners contesting a 65-year-old fence’s ownership claims. The court upheld that legal property boundaries in deeds are more valid than physical markers like fences. Neighbours Dan Hittle and the Loftuses presented conflicting arguments regarding the ownership of 5.13 acres. The Loftuses' adverse possession claim was rejected due to insufficient evidence of an agreed boundary.
title: Kansas court rejects neighbours' claim to 5.13 acres behind 65-year-old fence

author: IPSITA PATI
description: Haryana's cities have not met the annual PM10 air quality standard set by the government since 2019. Monitoring data indicates that all cities exceeded the annual limit, raising concerns about systemic pollution issues. Varied readings from each city show steep fluctuations in PM10 levels over the years. The National Clean Air Programme needs to include more cities across Haryana to address pollution comprehensively.
title: All Haryana cities breached annual PM10 limit every year since 2019

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Kentucky appeals court ruled that a district court could not investigate Tamara Williams' mental capacity claim. The dispute arose over her choice to reject her late husband Julian D. Williams' will for a statutory share. After her husband's death, Tamara's decision was contested by his stepchildren, who claimed she lacked mental capacity. The appeals court determined that contested cases must be resolved in circuit court rather than district court.
title: Widow rejected will after 54-year marriage; court halts capacity challenge

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: George Harrison's Material World Foundation continues to thrive, providing substantial funding to charitable initiatives worldwide. In 2024 alone, the foundation allocated over £573,000 towards public health, education, and emergency relief efforts. Operated independently by a board of trustees including Olivia Harrison, it eschews salaries to focus all resources on its mission. Founded from royalties of Harrison's classic album, Living in the Material World, the foundation's influence endures, promoting lasting change.
title: George Harrison's 1973 royalty gift lives on: £573K charity spend in 2024 alone

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: M Padmavathi founded the Community Renovation and Organisation Advancement Trust to promote economic empowerment in her community. This organization aids goldsmiths, underprivileged children, and transgender individuals in securing financial stability. Between 2015 and 2020, around 4,200 students benefited from after-school coaching programs, while initiatives also aimed at connecting transgender individuals with government resources and employment opportunities. Her dedication illustrates a profound commitment to uplift lives and nurture self-sufficiency.
title: Woman dreamt collector, built trust aiding goldsmiths, students, trans housing

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Labuschagne has been afforded more chances than most, but Australian cricket has a history of punishing batters whose judgement deserts them against South Africa.
title: From outranking Fab Four to fight for place: Rise, reign & unraveling of Labuschagne

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Brazil’s Lula wins re-election, defeating Trump ally Bolsonaro

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Kansas appeals court recently vacated a previous ruling in a divorce property case, asserting that Scott L. Hale was not given a fair chance to participate. Haltingly unable to attend his hearing due to incarceration, Scott's objections to the property division were overlooked by the trial judge. The court's decision sends the matter back to the lower court for a comprehensive reassessment and new hearing.
title: Husband jailed next door missed hearing, lost home; court reopens case
